business_problem: Greater efficiency on the cybersecurity front translates into other cherished NTT Communications goals. “The operational efficiencies we gain with Security Copilot help reduce our environmental impact,” concludes Toyoshima.
solution_summary: The telecom rolled out Microsoft 365 E5 security features to protect data across its productivity app landscape while providing security teams with Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender solutions, capping the rollout with Security Copilot. NTT significantly lowered workload and related costs of analyzing PowerShell and other scripts. It onboards junior analysts faster and heightens everyone’s productivity with Security Copilot, providing a higher level of security without expanding its security team. Daily exposure to threats, coupled with a shortage of skilled security personnel, sparked NTT Communications’s search for a connected, proactive, and productivity-enhancing security platform for its global estate.
